rationale: Describes network performance testing, measurement, active service testing and remote monitoring to provide end-to-end visibility, conventional telecom monitoring functions.
evidence_spans: With our powerful network testing and measurement software, TEMS Sense, you can implement automated, remote monitoring of service performance from a variety of locations.
Using comprehensive active service testing capabilities, TEMS Sense provides complete end-to-end service performance visibility so you can avoid potential issues.
